title: graphify toggle state (v1)
description: Per-project graphify feature toggle. Single source of truth at <project>/.ai-playbook/graphify.json. Read/written exclusively through scripts/graphify/toggle.py. UI consumers MUST go through the CLI (python -m scripts.graphify) rather than touching the file directly. No 'mode' — graphify has no intensity levels.

schema.description: Schema versioning hook. MUST be 'graphify-toggle/v1' for this version. Future bumps require a migration script under scripts/graphify/migrations/.

enabled.description: Master switch. When false, all components are inert regardless of their individual flags.

agent_guidance.description: Inject the graphify query-first guidance block into AGENTS.md (materialise from skills/graphify/SKILL.md).

gitignore_hygiene.description: Run the graphify-adoption rule's apply so per-machine/per-run graph state is gitignored.

enforce_skill.description: Capability flag — gates the graphify skill. No side effect.

components.description: Per-component flags. agent_guidance/gitignore_hygiene are persistent side effects; enforce_skill is a capability gate.

applied_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of the last write. Used by audit/telemetry.

applied_by.description: Identifier of the agent/user that last toggled state. Optional. Sourced from $USER / $USERNAME by the CLI; UI consumers should set explicitly.
